physicalPages.finding: The paper describes setting alpha close to zero every 3000 iterations. It gives an interval and general behavior, not an exact reset value or implementation.
The figure caption identifies Bicycle as an evaluated Mip-NeRF360 scene. It does not establish the image manifest, number of captures or capture order.

proposalIssues: The proposal says the paper does not report the reset interval, although page 5 gives it.
The fit step uses an undefined paper_default opacity setting.
The split rule uses indices divisible by eight with floor(N/8), without declaring an index origin. A one-based origin makes this count consistent.
Four arms in one matched scene/checkpoint block cannot serve as independent replications for uncertainty.
sourceDiagnosis.boundary: Fulltext inspection diagnoses an acquisition gap before model review. It does not adopt any verdict from the truncated historical response or reopen the historical run.
